provenance.client: KakaoTalk Android (primary phone; version not recorded)
provenance.method: The account owner sent one photo from their primary Android phone into an owned 1:1 chat. The bridge's opt-in gap dump (network.gap_dump_dir) captured the MSG push; a local shape reader recorded only chat-log and attachment key sets, value kinds and string lengths. All values below are synthetic; string lengths of k, rsc, rt and hfac match the observation (58, 58, 2, 10).

expected: Decodes as a photo and bridges as a Matrix image with the exact downloaded bytes. The Mac client's LocoChatLogPhoto has no checksum property and its download verifies only the length (research/bridge/GROUP-PHOTOS.md), so an empty cs must not reject or fail the photo.
